continuation_basis: The active user goal explicitly requests continued actual multi-agent optimization. Round 3 is closed and immutable; its quality gate was not achieved.
new_phase: Candidate C addresses diagnosed coast/product planning failures. Repeat all four original cases, then use three held-out images.
accounting: Keep every historical call. Record C first-production and repairs separately, and maintain cumulative attempts for repeated original cases. Do not claim the additional tests remain inside the closed Round 3 two-attempt cap. This is the user-requested continued skill-evaluation phase; ordinary automatic repair policy stays two per new output.
mandatory_gate: Exact visible copy, requested quantity and aspect ratios within 1 percent relative tolerance, single flat images, explicit style fidelity, actual native files, complete required information readable at width 720.
quality_gate: Each selected image needs content/form, typography, image/material, and AI-slop avoidance >=4 with located evidence; each multi-image case set needs diversity >=4. Evaluate all seven dimensions, preserve concrete incomplete work and disagreements, and do not average away a 3. Do not infer authorship, physical properties, print performance, or universal future quality.
review_independence: Fresh reviewers receive only raw requests, anonymized native/720/320 images, tolerances and the unchanged rubric. Hide prompts, plans, versions, prospective winners and peer reports.
